notes.title: Devlog #5
notes.content:
Hi all! Winter has come, and so is our new devlog!

ExTime: Approaching the first frontier

Welcome to the tropical bounty in the middle of the ocean: a land of untouched nature and stoning views! Roar Island is our first island and that’s where your gaming adventure begins. On this very island, you’ll learn more about the storyline, drop by the scientific research facility, and maybe crush a prehistoric party. It’s been a while since we started working on detailed sites of Roar Island, as a matter of fact, we still do. Right now we’re upgrading weather conditions and lighting to make them look more indigenous and spot-on.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/e1655827ab0ef726af052011dd7cccf08b205862.png
Animation and cut-scenes

This month we've put our efforts into the animation improvement, focusing on main in-game enemies and also some cut-scenes. These are quite substantial for creating surroundings and various plot features. That is why we’re aiming not only to boost the animation quality but also to work into deeper emotional cinematics for you to dive into the ExTime: Primal Menace realm.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/a4efa494f0315ea6bc33fff198d4b89ebdc27346.png
Optimizing game for our invaluable community

Image quality and smoothness play a pivotal role in the experience that you can get while playing. That’s why our efforts now are geared towards increasing the FPS so the game would run comfortably without decreasing productivity across various devices. Using the GTX1060 allows you to play at ease on recommended graphic settings even in the biggest locations. Moreover, further updates on this matter will bring even better rates. We're dedicated to ensuring that ExTime: Primal Menace is reachable and enjoyable for all players.

Thank you for your support and anticipation! We aspire to create a world that won’t leave you indifferent. Stay tuned as we are crafting something truly amazing!

notes.title: Devlog #4
notes.content:
Hello, dear friends! We are glad to share our latest news with you, so if you wondering what’s new in ExTime: Primal Menace, let’s get started!

DETAILING LOCATIONS

As you may remember, in ExTime you get on a specific island in Bermudas for scientific research. And, there is a lot of military stuff everywhere… Hmm, how can it be of use to us? Seems like it’s going to be one of the game puzzles for players.

Today we show you some screenshots of our military base. Firstly, you can see a construction near the main entrance, and by the way, do you have any thoughts, what it was built for? Anyway, we do not strongly recommend hiding there, while you're chased by a couple of predators. It may not be safe for you there.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/3632ca3518f92d38cd259f6f9f93acb8e14e7483.jpg
Secondly, there is a warehouse backyard, where you can see a huge tank in a sinister embedded in a dark night atmosphere. What (or even who) could be in that tank — all questions and no answers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/a2349a39bc5fcef8764f7ab2237051283e10419f.jpg

CREATING VISUAL EFFECTS

This part is the most sacred for all developers, but we still want to show you a piece of our work. So, what should you do to start a fire? 

At the beginning, all you have is a room, and of course, a plan of how you will add special effects in there. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/9b7d9d74e7ecd140bf804b9943d9cc0c6800609a.jpg
Then the magic starts, or VFX, as we call it, and also don’t forget about logical elements. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/5f6a4a97fcaf756b7f5b60cac7197ff9c0a798d5.jpg
If you do everything right, in the end, you have a perfect conflagration.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/2043530075c33fb7f0a96504326632e21643aac8.jpg

GAME WITHIN THE GAME

Mini-games often become a necessary part of a big project, and ExTime: Primal Menace is not going to become an exception. At every level, several puzzles will await you, and none of them will be easy. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/250895fd53e1e54587f6a6ba3d4e7b5ea5a659c5.jpg
Cracking a code, getting access to the terminal, picking a lock to break in or out — these and lots of other quests will undoubtedly be in “ExTime”. Some of them may remind you of famous references but don’t get carried away, as solving these puzzles may be essential for saving your life.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/4d07611ed91adfb5952b16e9b585c21cdd8bbad6.jpg

That’s all for today, but if you want to know more about our development progress, follow our socials on Twitter @vega_horizon, or Facebook page! We weekly post new work-in-progress videos and screenshots, and communicate with you!

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.content:
Hey, everyone! Here is our devlog #3. We’ve been developing “ExTime: Primal Menace” for quite a long time and are ready to show you some new stuff.

THE OFFICE

Not exactly what you might have thought, but this is where “ARROW” employees used to work. What is “ARROW”, and what kind of work did they use to do? To find out, you should subscribe to our social media! We’ll uncover this secret when we get 500 followers on our Twitter @vega_horizon. However, as you can see in these screenshots, we’re developing a dark horror game where fear and curiosity are your main companions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/89a2a223d8b63d4c295e0f4dc72ec1c2f7752071.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/a14f7ef3b02a9157d0b813ae2416098a4f70d74c.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/b33e93f1ecaa9900508fca2f1d7efcd9671845b0.jpg

MODELING A FEMALE CHARACTER

This has to be a real surprise for you, guys, as we’re announcing only for the first time that this supermodel will become one of the main characters in our game. You’ll get to know her closer in a few months, but currently, we’re still working on her appearance, mimics, and movements. Anyone likes to play for a girl in action-adventure games, right? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/46d1716c3ed7f959d6d7970759e6f7ad711b71d7.jpg

DETAILS MATTER MOST

We want to make our game accurate and high-quality, so we can’t use just some default boxes and electronic devices. Our designers put a lot of effort into creating authentic pieces of art. Let’s show you some of them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/9078699928fa343c47ec4a8843f38d43b4e668b2.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/60d93babf504035147876d980be83195c82ff462.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/0f0f5499ac18a815fe84711c66acde458aabb8ee.jpg

We got to go, as there’s still much work for us to do. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.content:
Hello, world! Welcome to devlog #2 of our project ExTime: Primal Menace. There's been a lot of new stuff lately, so let's reveal everything step by step.

THE LAB

The breathtaking sci-fi atmosphere awaits you. A lot of secrets hide behind these doors and corridors. It is one of the critical locations where the main character has to solve challenging puzzles and figure out the whole story of the place.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/821d7233423f8eda177505b74c33db4ffb87b04f.jpg

CARNOTAURUS

The BIGGEST news of the month is that we are adding a new predator to the game, the terrifying Carnotaurus. It is hungry enough to hunt you and fast enough to catch you. So it’ll be a real challenge to stay alive and well.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/3f88b9ab5e560a1227b45752d92c407030bc168c.png

DISCOVERING NEW HORIZONS

We’ve started developing our second island, and though it’s at an early stage, we’re ready to show you some pictures of it.
Just look at these screenshots! It's a true tropical paradise, and there will be more of it soon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/26efaa0e2137f3c4970e89ddc98f6fe67ff4cad6.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43871372/d2d06c578fbce507cecdb3b9aa929b9b3fb1363a.jpg

Stay tuned!
